fix(postgres): align activity lease recovery

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-14
  description: |-
    Allow idle-lease and resource-ceiling expiry observations for dispatches whose dispatch and operation are both recovery-required, while preserving running-state runtime-reference validation.
    
    Scope activity lease restart readback to the full dispatch identity and fence so replacement dispatches cannot read retained terminal projections. Add PostgreSQL regressions for recovery expiry and replacement-dispatch readback.
